---
title: "Sea Ice Extent"
toc: False
---

This site presents sea ice extent and thickness across regions off Alaska, aligned with 
Large Marine Ecosystems supported by AKFIN. You can explore how sea ice 
changes over time, visualize recent conditions, and download data for further analysis.

## Explore the Data

Use the links below to visualize sea ice extent and access data:

- [Daily Time Series of Recent Years](daily-ts.qmd)  
  Visualize recent seasonal cycles and current conditions.

- [Annualized Time Series of sea ice extent (1985–Present)](annual-ts.qmd)  
  Explore long-term trends and variability in sea ice extent.

- [Annualized Time Series of sea ice thickness (March and April average; 2011–Present)](CHANGE.qmd)  
  Explore long-term trends and variability in sea ice thickness.

## Acknowledgement

The data and methods used in this site are based on work from the 
[NOAA PolarWatch project](https://polarwatch.github.io/alaska-seaice).
